name: Electric Charge, Mass Greater
body:
School evocation [electricity]; Level sorcerer/wizard 9, witch 9

EFFECT

Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 15)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as greater electric charge except it affects multiple targets.
